posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: The Brewers announced the BBWAA's Milwaukee chapter award winners. Most Valuable Player: Brice Turang Most Valuable Pitcher: Jacob Misiorowski (unanimous) Most Valuable Newcomer: Cooper Pratt Unsung Hero: Abner Uribe Good Guy Award: Christian Yelich How would you have voted?

reply_texts.text: I think they got it right when you consider Turang’s defense along with his bat.  Could have been Chourio too.  Aaron Ashby was very valuable but his pitching really peaked later in the season and Uribe was valuable all year.  This team had so many great players who all stepped up when needed.
reply_texts.author: cherlombardi.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Hard to argue with Turang, and Misiorowski unanimous feels right. Yelich winning Good Guy is the least surprising line.
reply_texts.author: boxingmetrics.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Believe it or not I think Bauers was slightly more important than Turang. Was more consistent during the season.
reply_texts.author: pericles261.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I might have gone Bauers for MVP, but can’t argue Turang for the offense/defense he brings. Unsung hero could have been so many this year! I like Abner but maybe Logan Henderson?
reply_texts.author: edge182.bsky.social

posts.jp: ブルワーズがBBWAAミルウォーキー支部の受賞者を発表。MVPはブライス・トゥラング、最優秀投手はジェイコブ・ミシオロウスキ（満票）、最優秀新戦力はクーパー・プラット、縁の下の力持ち賞はアブナー・ウリベ、グッドガイ賞はクリスチャン・イェリッチ。あなたならどう投票しますか？

posts.text: Kevin McGonigle voted Tiger of the Year by Detroit chapter of BBWAA. He joins Riley Greene and Mark Fidrych as the only rookies to win the award since it began in 1965. www.mlb.com/tigers/news/...
posts.jp: ケビン・マクゴニグルがBBWAAデトロイト支部の「タイガー・オブ・ザ・イヤー」に選出。1965年の創設以来、ルーキーでの受賞はライリー・グリーン、マーク・フィドリッチに続く3人目です。
